canonical_rule: Aweswell originated the separation application; Aweswell appealed through RPL 3319/2025; LPB independently appealed through RPL 3304/2025; the Audiencia Provincial accumulated the appeals; RPL 3304/2025 is the live consolidated appellate proceeding. Termination of the separate 3319 roll is not a merits dismissal absent source evidence.

pleaded_factual_blocks: fragmentation of the hotel operating unit

pleaded_factual_blocks_detailed.label: accounts / rendition of accounts
pleaded_factual_blocks_detailed.allegation: Prolonged failure to prepare and file annual accounts after LPB powers were suspended; the pleading relied among other materials on a 20 March 2025 court-office record that did not locate an exemption order or accounting documents at the point searched.
pleaded_factual_blocks_detailed.removal_relevance: Pleaded as an ongoing accountability and accounting-traceability problem and linked to the request for rendition of accounts and institutional communications.

pleaded_factual_blocks_detailed.label: financial risk / swap
pleaded_factual_blocks_detailed.allegation: Alleged inaction and later obstruction concerning the 2008 financial-risk-management contract; the pleading stated that it had caused more than EUR 500,000 of loss and might support an estate recovery claim.
pleaded_factual_blocks_detailed.removal_relevance: Pleaded as a failure to examine and protect a potentially valuable estate claim.

pleaded_factual_blocks_detailed.label: credit-assignment price / retract
pleaded_factual_blocks_detailed.allegation: Alleged obstruction or insufficient access to the true price and full terms of the credit assignment, linked in the pleading to litigation, negotiation, estate strategy and analysis of retract where legally applicable.
pleaded_factual_blocks_detailed.removal_relevance: Pleaded on the basis that incomplete economics of the assignment could obstruct informed liability and liquidation-alternative decisions.

pleaded_factual_blocks_detailed.label: dación en pago / fiscal valuation
pleaded_factual_blocks_detailed.allegation: The application challenged what it characterised as insufficiently critical acceptance or defence of a transfer/adjudication transaction and raised valuation, perimeter, authority and estate-protection questions.
pleaded_factual_blocks_detailed.removal_relevance: Pleaded as a challenge to the Administrator's recommendation/protective function; any later judicial decision remains distinct from the Administrator conduct alleged.

pleaded_factual_blocks_detailed.label: fragmentation of the hotel operating unit
pleaded_factual_blocks_detailed.allegation: Alleged inaction concerning fragmentation of the hotel as an economic unit and issues of access, operation and third-party assets or rights said to remain outside the insolvency estate.
pleaded_factual_blocks_detailed.removal_relevance: Pleaded as affecting value preservation, economic continuity, estate perimeter and operating/exit alternatives.

pleaded_factual_blocks_detailed.label: remuneration
pleaded_factual_blocks_detailed.allegation: Alleged accrual and receipt of remuneration outside liquidation time limits Aweswell said were applicable, together with interest on remuneration.
pleaded_factual_blocks_detailed.removal_relevance: Pleaded as an estate-cost, transparency and regularity issue; materially connected with but procedurally separate from the fees route and RPL 421/2026.

pleaded_factual_blocks_detailed.label: opacity / conflicts
pleaded_factual_blocks_detailed.allegation: Alleged information asymmetries and insufficient disclosure or management of relationships and conflicts said to affect independence, transparency and confidence in the office.
pleaded_factual_blocks_detailed.removal_relevance: Pleaded as a cross-cutting independence and disclosure issue rather than only an isolated-act allegation.

appellate_sequence.event: Auto 1377/2025 rejects on standing without entering substantive grounds
Reconsideration decision confirms refusal and appeal route remains available
Decreto 222/2026 records termination of separate RPL 3319/2025 roll because of accumulation
